title: Dining Tables Recalled by EQ3 Due to Collapse and Impact Hazards
summary: The wooden table base can split and/or collapse, causing the glass table top to fall. This poses collapse and impact hazards to consumers. Units: About 20.

title: Philips Lighting Recalls EnergySaver and Marathon Compact Fluorescent Dimmable Reflector Flood Lamps Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glue that attaches the glass outer envelope or globe to the body of the lamp can fail allowing the glass outer envelope to fall and strike persons and objects below, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.86 million.

title: Emergency Exit Signs Recalled by Best Lighting Products Due to Failure to Illuminate
summary: The fixtures can malfunction and fail to illuminate in the event of a power failure. This could result in a failure to provide adequate lighting to guide building occupants to an exit in the event of an emergency. Units: About 450.

title: Build-A-Bear Workshop Recalls Lapel Pins Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the lapel pin contain excessive levels of lead which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 26,500 pins in the United States and 2,200 in Canada.

title: Target Recalls Step Stools with Storage Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The wooden step stools can break apart or collapse under the weight of the user, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 206,000.

title: NexTorch Recalls Flashlight Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Batteries can overheat and rupture, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 16,000.

title: Cloud Engines Recalls Pogoplug Video File Sharing Device Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The unit can overheat or catch fire, emitting excessive heat, sparks, smoke or flames. Units: About 9,500 in the United States and 1,500 in Canada.

title: Toy Keys with Remote Recalled by Battat Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal toy keys and the plastic key ring can break, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 1,080,000 in the United States and 3,600 in Canada.

title: Fiskars Brands Recalls SmartPower String Trimmers Due to Burn, Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: Engine vibration during use of the trimmers can cause wear on the fuel line, leading to a propane fuel leak. The Straight Shaft Trimmers' propane canister can crack at the neck during use. title: Target Expands Recall of Step Stools with Storage Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The wooden step stools can break apart or collapse under the weight of the user, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 341,000 (206,000 were recalled on August 4, 2011).

title: C. O. Lynch Enterprises Inc. Recalls Itasca Fusion Hiker Boots Due to Foot Injury Hazard
summary: The boots could fail to provide the intended protection against compression and impact, posing the risk of a foot injury to consumers. The boots have hard composite toe material rather than steel. Units: About 5,200.

title: Macy's Recalls Martha Stewart Collection Enamel Cast Iron Casseroles Due to Laceration and Burn Hazard
summary: The enamel coating on the cast iron casseroles can crack or break during use. This can cause the enamel to crack and fly off as a projectile, posing a risk of laceration or burn hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 960,000.

title: Office Depot Recalls Desk Chairs Due to Pinch Hazard
summary: A consumer's finger can get caught in an opening in the chair's tilt mechanism, posing a pinch hazard to consumers. Units: About 34,000 in the United States and 425 in Canada.

title: Table-Top Clip-on Chair Recalled by phil&teds USA Due to Fall and Amputation Hazards
summary: Missing or worn clamp pads allow the chairs to detach from a variety of different table surfaces, posing a fall hazard. In addition, when the chair detaches, children's fingers can be caught between the bar and clamping mechanism, posing an amputation hazard. Also, user instructions for the chairs a

title: Riding Toy Recalled by Radio Flyer Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The riding toy can tip over allowing a child to fall forward while riding, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 165,000.

title: Umarex USA Recalls to Repair Browning 800 Mag Air Pistols; Pistols Can Fire Unexpectedly
summary: Under a variety of circumstances, the safety will not prevent the gun from firing. This poses a risk of serious injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 9,500.

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
summary: The sling-style swing seats can crack or split prematurely, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,500.

title: Petzl America Recalls Belay Devices Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Excessive force on the handle can cause it to become stuck in the open position. When stuck open, the assisted braking function is disabled, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,000 in the United States and about 2,000 in Canada.
